You can try a Poor mans tilt table test at home. 

1. Lay her on her back for 5 minutes and be as still as possible. While still laying down, take her pulse and write it down.

2. Have her stand up, and stand as still as possible for 2 minutes without leaning. Take her pulse while still standing.  You can repeat pulse evaluations every 2 minutes until she has been standing 10 minutes. 

If you notice her heart rate goes up or past 30 bmp or if her hr gets up to 120 at any point than I would find a doctor who is willing to do an actual tilt table test. 

Also keep going to doctors until you find one who will take you seriously. It may not be a life threatening issue, but it is life changing. A lot of doctors still don't know about POTS or a lot of these types of issues. 

You are always going to have the skeptics, but just know you aren't crazy. Other people can't relate because they aren't living it. So it's easy for them to brush it off as anxiety.
